params.name: category
params.description: If specified, only returns furniture of this type.

params.name: includeDraft
params.description: Whether to include draft furniture in the results.  Defaults to false.

params.name: newerThan
params.description: If specified, only returns stock furniture created after this timestamp.

params.name: next
params.description:
An opaque cursor used to request the next page of results.
It is provided in the previous response from the api.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. max: 200

items.docs:
Get a paginated list of stock furniture.  (i.e., well-known furniture
assets that can be placed in a room).

Subsequent pages can be requested with the "next" parameter, which is
returned in the response metadata object if another page exists.

Creates a new piece of stock furniture.  Can only be called by kumospace
admins.

params.name: category
params.description: If specified, only returns furniture variations of this type.

params.name: includeDraft
params.description: Whether to include draft furniture variations in the results.  Defaults to false.

params.name: newerThan
params.description: If specified, only returns stock furniture variations created after this timestamp.

params.name: next
params.description:
An opaque cursor used to request the next page of results.
It is provided in the previous response from the api.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. max: 200

items.docs:
Get a paginated list of furniture variations. (i.e., grouped well-known
furniture assets that can be placed in a room).

Subsequent pages can be requested with the "next" parameter, which is
returned in the response metadata object if another page exists.
